description: Do you still fold your own laundry? That might feel very 2025. In some cities across China, household robots are already working alongside human cleaners, handling repetitive tasks while people focus on more delicate work. The future of housework is arriving faster than you think! / China's internet finds its mascot: A tired opossum (15:18). On the show: Steve, Fei Fei & Yushun
classificationReason: The episode focuses on household robots performing laundry and other repetitive domestic tasks, though it includes another unrelated segment.
qualityReason: Provides focused reporting on an emerging robotics use case, but metadata suggests a short general-audience segment rather than a deep technical discussion.
